details:
ASTROVITAL – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTROVITAL is a proposed health monitoring software system designed to help astronauts monitor their physical and mental well-being during long-duration space missions.

Problem Statement:

Astronauts face several health challenges in space, including radiation exposure, microgravity, isolation and confinement. These conditions can cause changes in heart rate, sleep patterns, physical activity, bone health and mental well-being. Monitoring these changes is important for maintaining astronaut health.

Proposed Solution:

ASTROVITAL aims to provide a simple and user-friendly health monitoring dashboard where astronauts can record and view their health information in one place. It focuses on monitoring important indicators such as heart rate, sleep duration, physical activity and overall well-being.

Main Features:

  • Health information monitoring and recording.
  • Heart rate and sleep pattern tracking.
  • Physical activity monitoring.
  • Daily health check-ins.
  • Visual representation of health trends.
  • Reminders to seek medical support when necessary.

How It Works:

The proposed system collects health information through manual entries or compatible health-monitoring devices in a future implementation. The information is displayed on a dashboard, allowing astronauts to review their readings, compare changes over time and identify unusual patterns.

Benefits and Expected Impact:

ASTROVITAL aims to improve astronaut health awareness, encourage regular health monitoring and support early identification of potential health concerns. It can also help astronauts organise their health information for communication with medical teams.

Tools and Technologies:

The current project is presented as a software concept with a dashboard design. Further development could use Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and database technologies to build an interactive application and integrate compatible sensors.

Creativity and Innovation:

The main idea is to bring multiple health indicators together in one accessible platform specifically designed around the challenges of space missions. The concept focuses on simplicity, health awareness and the needs of astronauts in remote environments.

Future Scope:

Future improvements may include wearable sensor integration, real-time health data collection, personalised health trend analysis and secure data storage.

ASTROVITAL aims to support healthier and safer long-duration space exploration through accessible health monitoring.
